item.title: With FDA approval of Wegovy pill, new era of oral GLP-1 weight loss drugs begins
item.description: The US Food and Drug Administration on Monday approved a daily pill version of Novo Nordisk's weight-loss drug Wegovy, introducing a new option for how patients can take medicines in a class of drugs that has revolutionized obesity treatment.

item.title: New Korean crime thriller, 'Made in Korea,' unfolds a world of espionage and deadly power struggles
item.description: "Made in Korea" is a new crime thriller about a KCIA agent living a double life and the prosecutor determined to stop him.

item.title: SF Sunset businesses rally after 40-hour PG&E outage coincides with winter solstice celebration
item.description: "Without power, how can you survive?" Some Sunset District businesses reported losing $40,000 - 60,000 as they had to empty out large inventory for Sunday's Winter Solstice celebration.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Scattered showers wind down this evening; stronger storm on the way tomorrow
item.description: Scattered light showers will wind down this afternoon and evening with this level 1 system on the exclusive ABC7 Storm Impact Scale. Standing water is likely. Additional rainfall accumulation today will be trace amounts to .20," except in the far North Bay and in the higher elevations.

item.description: "Fired" up for the holidays? Get in the spirit by streaming "Frozen," "The Simpsons" and more Christmas yule logs streaming on Disney+!

item.title: Search suspended for missing California swimmer after possible shark attack
item.description: A search has been suspended for a missing woman who was swimming off the coast of Monterey after reports of a possible shark attack Sunday afternoon. One person reported seeing a shark with a body in its mouth before it submerged, a Coast Guard official said.

item.title: At least 5 killed after Mexican Navy plane on medical mission crashes in Texas
item.description: Four of the people aboard were Navy officers and four were civilians, including a child, Mexico's Navy said in a statement.

item.title: Impacted by the SF power outage? Here's how to file a claim with PG&E
item.description: If you were one of the thousands of people in San Francisco that have been affected by the power outage, you might be entitled to a credit from PG&E.

item.title: Placer County crews rescue baby, family from home surrounded by raging river
item.description: Footage released by CHP shows crews using a ladder to carefully slide the baby in a carrier over the raging river. Nine people were rescued after the home they were in became surrounded by the raging South Yuba River.

item.title: SF power outage spurs utility scrutiny; political leaders calls for PG&E reform
item.description: "Monopolies don't work. They provide the worst service at the highest price." The outage has also become a flashpoint in the 2026 governor's race, with Democratic candidate Tom Steyer using the moment to renew his push for utility reform.
